data.one_liner: A web framework for building websites in Dart with Flutter-like syntax and server-side rendering.
data.what_it_does: Jaspr allows developers to build web applications using a component model that feels like Flutter, supporting both client-side and server-side rendering, automatic state syncing, and optimized DOM updates.
use_when: You want to build websites in Dart with a Flutter-like component model.
You need server-side rendering (SSR) for web applications written in Dart.
You prefer writing web layouts using component composition and HTML element components.
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile or desktop application rather than a website.
You require a vast out-of-the-box library of pre-styled Material or Cupertino components.
strengths: Familiar component model for Flutter developers.
Built-in server-side rendering and automatic state sync between server and client.
Optimized DOM updates and CLI tool support with hot reloading.
weaknesses: Does not include pre-styled Material or Cupertino components.
Styling relies on CSS/stylesheets rather than property-based widget styling.
data.setup_notes: Activate the jaspr_cli globally and use `jaspr create` to scaffold a new project.
